description: Skill summary: a stop hook that, every 20 completed turns, hands a condensed excerpt of the session to a background subagent, which folds the durable findings into the agent's own skills.
description_zh: 技能沉淀：一个 stop hook，每累积 20 个完成的轮次就把会话的浓缩摘录交给一个后台子会话，由它把值得沉淀的发现写进 Agent 自己的 Skill。
short_description: Fold a long session's findings back into the agent's skills.
short_description_zh: 把长会话的发现回流进 Agent 的 Skill。
